summary: ci(circleci): cut PR build and test time
description:
Because:

- PR CI took a median 17.2m, mostly Init, workspace hand-offs and functional-test setup
- Test jobs already read builds from the nx remote cache, not Build's workspace

This commit:

- Drops Init and PR workspaces: Build runs first, and each job installs over the yarn cache
- Starts the functional-test stack with build-fast in two pm2 batches, fixing build-fast output gaps
- Shards auth-server integration suites and runs settings Jest with workers
- Fixes an OAuth client seeding race and a pairAttribution tab-navigation race
- Builds settings bundle variants in parallel and skips gcloud setup on PR jobs
